title: Artifact Registry Definition Structure Schema
description: Schema for defining an artifact's definition structure. Each artifact provides a definitionStructure.json instance that describes the files in its definition folder. Supports both JSON and non-JSON file types (e.g., images, binary assets) via glob patterns.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema for tooling support

format.description: Optional format identifier. Workloads can define multiple definition structures when they support different formats (e.g., 'compact', 'full', 'tmdl').

files.description: List of file definitions that make up this artifact's definition structure. Supports glob patterns for matching files of any type, including non-JSON files such as images or other binary assets.
